tooltips.inputMode: Switch input mode: Scramble, Alg, or Position.
tooltips.apply: Apply the input. Shift+Enter first resets the cube to solved.
tooltips.metric: Choose how move length is counted: Slice, Move, or Angle metric.
tooltips.twoGen: Restrict solving to 2 Gen or Pseudo 2 Gen move sets.
tooltips.angle: Lock the pre-ABF angle move to +/-1 or 0.
tooltips.normalize: Control which ABF moves are normalized in the output.
tooltips.all: Find all optimal solutions, or optimal plus extra depths.
tooltips.suboptimal: Extra moves beyond optimal to also find.
tooltips.generator: Output algs that set up the case from solved instead of solving it.
tooltips.cubeshape: Only generate algs that keep the puzzle in cubeshape throughout.
tooltips.ignoreEquator: Ignore equator states. Equivalent to clicking the middle bar until it is gray.
tooltips.karn: Display solutions in karnotation instead of WCA notation.
tooltips.maxX: Limit the maximum top-layer turn in either direction (0-6).
tooltips.maxY: Limit the maximum bottom-layer turn in either direction (0-6).
tooltips.maxTotal: Limit the maximum combined |top|+|bottom| turn per move pair (1-12).
tooltips.depths: Comma-separated list of depths to search, e.g. 8,9.

about.title: About Croissant
about.p1: This program stemmed from the optimal Square-1 solver by <link:jaap>Jaap Scherphuis</link:jaap>.
about.p2: v2 was created by Michael Gottlieb (<link:github>GitHub</link:github>, <link:wca>WCA</link:wca>), who rewrote the solver with significant improvements and optimisations.
about.p3: Read the old documentations <link:here>here</link:here>. Note that it is largely not applicable within v3.
about.p4: This is the official v3. New in v3:
about.li2: Ability to generate a solution from a specific angle
about.p5: v3 is created by <link:abid>Abid Ibn Ashraf</link:abid> and <link:matt>Matt Mao</link:matt>.

howToUse.title: How to Use
howToUse.shortcut3: Ctrl + Enter = Start or stop the solver
howToUse.shortcut4: Ctrl + Z = Undo state change   Ctrl + Y = Redo state change
howToUse.swapHint: Click on two pieces to swap them. Or use the below shortcuts (identical to cstimer):
howToUse.shortcutJ: J = U, only by one piece   F = U′, only by one piece
howToUse.shortcutS: S = D, only by one piece   L = D′, only by one piece
howToUse.shortcutH: H = U, by two pieces   G = U′, by two pieces
howToUse.shortcutW: W = D, by two pieces   O = D′, by two pieces
howToUse.applyHint: Type some moves and hit Apply. Karn will be parsed correctly.
howToUse.modeHint: Use the mode button (to the left of the input) to switch between three modes:
howToUse.modeScram: Scram: applies moves forward as a scramble
howToUse.modeAlg: Alg: inverts before applying, useful for testing algs
howToUse.modePos: Pos: interprets the input as a string of the raw state (e.g. A1B2C4D38E6F7G5H)
howToUse.enterHint: For the first two modes, use Enter to apply the moves from the current state, or Shift + Enter to first reset the cube to solved state before applying.
howToUse.hoverHint: Hover over any option to read its description. Quick reference:
howToUse.descOutput: Output: toggle between Solution (solve from current state) and Setup (generate a scramble that leads to the current state).
howToUse.descMetric: Metric: how move length is counted — Slice (only slices), Move (layer turns too), or Angle.
howToUse.desc2Gen: 2 Gen / Pseudo 2 Gen: restrict moves to top-layer turns and slices (or a pseudo variant).
howToUse.descAll: Generate All Solutions: find every shortest solution, not just the first one found. Use the −/+ stepper to also return solutions up to N moves beyond optimal.
howToUse.descDepths: Specific depths: search only the listed move counts (comma-separated, e.g. "8,9").
howToUse.descCubeshape: Stay in cubeshape: restrict to algs that keep the puzzle in cubeshape throughout. Automatically disabled when the position is incompatible.
howToUse.descAngle: Lock layer angle on Pre-ABF: constrain the pre-ABF move to ±1 or 0 on either/both layers.
howToUse.descNormalize: Normalize ABF: simplify ABF moves in the output (e.g. 3-1 → 0-1, 43 → 10).
howToUse.descLimits: Max top / bottom / total turns: cap how large layer turns can be.
howToUse.descSettingsOpen: Opened from the <icon:dots> menu in the top bar. Options:
howToUse.descIgnoreTransforms: Ignore move equivalences: generate all possible algs, even with y2 algs.
howToUse.outputIntro: Solutions appear in the terminal as they are found. The output area has two views:
howToUse.descTerminalView: Terminal view: solutions stream in as they are found, like a log.
howToUse.descTableView: Table view: a sorted, comparable list of all solutions with move counts and ergonomics. Auto-enabled when 2 or more solutions are found.
howToUse.descContextMenu: Right-click (or left-click in table view) on any solution to open a context menu:
howToUse.descCopyAlg: ⧉ Copy alg — copies the alg itself
howToUse.descAddFav: ♥ Add to Favorites Bin — saves the alg to a bin
howToUse.otherButtons: Other buttons in the terminal area:
howToUse.outputTools1: Notation control — opens the output notation modal. Numeric: Sq1opt default, Clean (no commas, spaces around slices), WCA (parenthesized pairs), or Abid (WCA with barred numbers and no interior slashes). Karnotation: Traditional Karn or Smart Karn (cubeshape-aware). Use Abid's negative number representation applies to karnotation styles.
howToUse.outputTools2: ⧉ — copy all algs in the terminal to the clipboard.
howToUse.outputTools3: ⊞ / ▤ — switch between terminal and table view.
howToUse.outputTools4: ⤢ — expand the terminal to full screen.
howToUse.descErgo: If Stay in cubeshape was active, algs will be roughly sorted by their ergonomics. The numbers are relative and for reference only.
howToUse.favIntro: Algs can be saved to bins for later reference. Open the Favorites Bin from the <icon:heart> button in the top bar.
howToUse.favAdd: Right-click (or left-click in table view) on any solution to add it to a bin.
howToUse.favBinId: Bins are identified by the configurations of the solve, so algs from the same setup always land in the same bin regardless of when they were added.
howToUse.favInside: Inside the Favorites Bin, you can:
howToUse.favApply: Click Apply setup to re-apply a bin's configuration and clear the terminal.
howToUse.favRemove: Click <icon:close> next to any alg to remove it.
howToUse.favStorage: Favorited algs are stored on your device, unless you delete them.
